sample_rows.chủ đề: Economic Policy & Debt: Balance of payments: Current account: Goods, services & income
sample_rows.Tên chỉ số: Imports of goods, services and primary income (current US$)
sample_rows.định nghĩa ngắn: Imports of goods, services and primary income is the sum of goods (merchandise) imports, imports of (nonfactor) services and income (factor) payments. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
sample_rows.Định nghĩa chi tiết: Imports of goods, services and income is the sum of goods (merchandise) imports, imports of (nonfactor) services and primary income (factor) payments. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
sample_rows.nguồn: International Monetary Fund, Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook.

sample_rows.chủ đề: Economic Policy & Debt: Balance of payments: Current account: Balances
sample_rows.định nghĩa ngắn: Current account balance shows the difference between the sum of exports and income receivable and the sum of imports and income payable (exports and imports refer to both goods and services, while income refers to both primary and secondary income).
sample_rows.Định nghĩa chi tiết: Current account balance shows the difference between the sum of exports and income receivable and the sum of imports and income payable (exports and imports refer to both goods and services, while income refers to both primary and secondary income).
sample_rows.nguồn: International Monetary Fund, Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook.

sample_rows.chủ đề: Economic Policy & Debt: Balance of payments: Reserves & other items
sample_rows.định nghĩa ngắn: Grants are defined as legally binding commitments that obligate a specific value of funds available for disbursement for which there is no repayment requirement. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
sample_rows.Định nghĩa chi tiết: Grants are defined as legally binding commitments that obligate a specific value of funds available for disbursement for which there is no repayment requirement. Data are in current U.S. dollars.

sample_rows.chủ đề: Economic Policy & Debt: Balance of payments: Reserves & other items
sample_rows.định nghĩa ngắn: Technical cooperation grants include free-standing technical cooperation grants, which are intended to finance the transfer of technical and managerial skills or of technology for the purpose of building up general national capacity without reference to any specific investment projects; and investment-related technical cooperation grants, which are provided to strengthen the capacity to execute specific investment projects. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
sample_rows.Định nghĩa chi tiết: Technical cooperation grants include free-standing technical cooperation grants, which are intended to finance the transfer of technical and managerial skills or of technology for the purpose of building up general national capacity without reference to any specific investment projects; and investment-related technical cooperation grants, which are provided to strengthen the capacity to execute specific investment projects. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
